preconditions: Take and verify an OpenSearch snapshot before the first write canary.
Capture document, occurrence, chunk, embedding and corpus digests.
Persist the exact document-level result log and checkpoint outside the worker pod.
canary_rollback: Select only occurrences recorded as SUCCESS by the canary result log.
Require the same document_id, source_entity_id or local source_url, owner, ingest_run_id and document_content_sha256 guards used for the forward write.

Remove only document_metadata_profile, document_metadata_facts_sha256, document_metadata_profile_id, document_metadata_profile_version, document_metadata_extractor_name and document_metadata_extractor_version from the unique chunk_index=0 representative.
Verify exactly one representative update per selected occurrence and stop on any count mismatch.
Re-run DLS, corpus, chunk, embedding, GT1, GT2 and scope-coverage checks.
limitations: OpenSearch field mappings are additive and remain after field values are removed.
A snapshot restore is the recovery path for an unexpected mutation outside the metadata allowlist.
No rollback action is authorized or executed by dry-run mode.
